batchRequest.request: Rotate the kitchen and bathroom assignments, and add a monthly window-cleaning chore.

patchOf:
root = Stack([header, chores, tip])
header = InlineHeader("Household Chore Rotation", "Weekly room assignments and due days")
chores = Table([colRoom, colOwner, colTask, colDue, colDone])
colRoom = Col("Room", ["Kitchen", "Bathroom", "Living Room", "Bedroom", "Laundry"])
colOwner = Col("Responsible", ["Alex", "Jamie", "Priya", "Sam", "Alex"])
colTask = Col("Task", ["Clean counters and sink", "Scrub toilet and shower", "Vacuum and dust", "Change sheets", "Run washer and dryer"])
colDue = Col("Due", ["Mon", "Wed", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"])
colDone = Col("Done", [doneKitchen, doneBathroom, doneLiving, doneBedroom, doneLaundry])
doneKitchen = CheckBoxGroup("done_kitchen", [kitchenItem])
kitchenItem = CheckBoxItem("Completed", "Kitchen done this week", "kitchen_done", false)
doneBathroom = CheckBoxGroup("done_bathroom", [bathroomItem])
bathroomItem = CheckBoxItem("Completed", "Bathroom done this week", "bathroom_done", false)
doneLiving = CheckBoxGroup("done_living", [livingItem])
livingItem = CheckBoxItem("Completed", "Living room done this week", "living_done", false)
doneBedroom = CheckBoxGroup("done_bedroom", [bedroomItem])
bedroomItem = CheckBoxItem("Completed", "Bedroom done this week", "bedroom_done", false)
doneLaundry = CheckBoxGroup("done_laundry", [laundryItem])
laundryItem = CheckBoxItem("Completed", "Laundry done this week", "laundry_done", false)
tip = TextCallout("info", "Rotation tip", "Swap responsible people each week so everyone covers every room over time.")
request: Rotate the kitchen and bathroom assignments, and add a monthly window-cleaning chore.
